senses.example: Hun øver sig på klaver hver dag.
senses.example_translation: She practices the piano every day.

senses.example_translation: She leans against the wall while talking on the phone.

senses.example_translation: He insists that we should leave now.

senses.text: to drop out (of a group, course)

senses.example_translation: Many students drop out during the first year.

senses.example_translation: They live on a small pension.

senses.example_translation: I put up with the noise from the road.

senses.example_translation: The city has developed a lot in recent years.

senses.example_translation: She allowed herself a small piece of cake with the coffee.

senses.example: Han tillod sig at afbryde chefen under mødet.
senses.example_translation: He allowed himself to interrupt the boss during the meeting.

senses.example_translation: I'm sad because my cat is sick.
